description: Implementation of a memory pool management system with functions for initialization, allocation, string formatting, duplication, and merging of memory blocks.

classes.name: git_max_alignment
classes.description: Structure used to determine maximum alignment requirements for memory allocations.

methods.name: mem_pool_alloc_block
methods.description: Allocates a new memory block and inserts it into the memory pool, either after a specified block or at the head.

methods.name: mem_pool_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory pool with an optional initial size.

methods.name: mem_pool_discard
methods.description: Frees all memory blocks in the pool, optionally invalidating the memory.

methods.name: mem_pool_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a memory chunk of specified size from the pool, with alignment considerations.

methods.name: mem_pool_strvfmt
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into the memory pool.

methods.name: mem_pool_strfmt
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into the memory pool, wrapper around mem_pool_strvfmt.

methods.name: mem_pool_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory from the pool.

methods.name: mem_pool_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string into the memory pool.

methods.name: mem_pool_strndup
methods.description: Duplicates a string with a specified length into the memory pool.

methods.name: mem_pool_contains
methods.description: Checks if a given memory pointer is within the pool's allocated blocks.

methods.name: mem_pool_combine
methods.description: Merges two memory pools by appending the blocks of one to the other.
